invariants.test: The system widens embodied choice and never requires disappearance into identity, machine, market, or myth.
Generative range remains bounded by attributable authorial law.
Representation may change without counterfeiting continuity or silently replacing meaning.
Attention changes emphasis or probability, never canonical truth.
Refusal, delay, withdrawal, silence, and non-action remain valid states.
Material transformations retain an inspectable and attributable history.
Capability does not erase another participant's capacity to remain in the field.
Canon, attestation, settlement, transport, and presentation retain distinct authority.
Every layer performs structural work that a simpler form cannot.
Relations expose evidence, epistemic status, correction paths, and unresolved uncertainty.

revisionProtocol.promotionRule: Promote an observation only after it survives more than one context or when omission creates material risk.
